description: Tasmanian Freight Equalisation Scheme and freight scheme reviews (1996 to 2020) is a group of 8 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by BITRE. Members: Tasmanian Freight Equalisation Scheme - Monitoring Report 2020; Tasmanian Freight Equalisation Scheme: A 'Landbridge' Approach to the Estimation of Subsidy Rates; Tasmanian Freight Equalisation Scheme: Discussion Paper September 1996; Tasmanian Freight Equalisation Scheme: Recommended Northbound Assistance Rates at 1 January 1978; and 4 more. Coverage is Australia and its states and territories, 1981 to 2020; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-09-12. Files and pages listed: HTML, PDF, ZIP (9 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU; other members not stated. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
